claims.text: The iconic Eiffel Tower was built by engineer Gustave Eiffel to be the grand centrepiece of the 1889 World's Fair.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Locally nicknamed 'La dame de fer' or 'Iron Lady', it was highly controversial at first and heavily criticised by France's leading artists and intellectuals.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Incredibly, the tower was almost entirely torn down in 1909 and was only saved because it proved useful as a giant telegraphy antenna.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Standing 330 metres tall, it held the impressive title of the world's tallest human-made structure for 41 years.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Engraved directly onto the iron framework are the names of 72 different French scientists, engineers, and mathematicians.
claims.subject: self

claims.text: Hidden away on the top third level is a private apartment that was built specifically for Gustave Eiffel to host VIP guests like Thomas Edison.
claims.subject: self
